text: Craiphtine, also called Craftine or Cratiny, is an Irish hero. To him many people credit the harp, the instrument that most defines Ireland. He figures in the myths of the hero Labhraigh, whose restless nights his tunes soothed. Craiphtine's playing grew so forceful that it could put whole armies to sleep. In wartime that made him a valued servant to his lord.
